0.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_AURVAEL_000_000
0.description: Adventure! Excitement! Glory! All that and more awaits you in the Diadem. Should you crave such delights in the depth of your soul, pray return to me when you have honed your skills.

1.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_000_001
1.description: In order to embark upon an Ishgardian exploratory mission, you and your party must meet the following requirements:

2.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_000_002
2.description: You must have completed the main scenario quest “Heavensward.”

3.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_000_003
3.description: You must be a level 60 Disciple of War or Magic.

4.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_000_004
4.description: To review your quest progression, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the main menu, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Journal<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

5.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_AURVAEL_000_010
5.description: Excellent timing, my good <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>! We seek volunteers for our next expedition. Will you be joining us?

6.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_Q1_000_000
6.description: What would you like to do?

7.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_A1_000_001
7.description: Register for an Ishgardian exploratory mission.

9.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_A1_000_003
9.description: Ask about rewards obtained during exploratory missions.

11.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_AURVAEL_000_100
11.description: You have the opportunity to stand at the forefront of a grand initiative and explore a new frontier: the Diadem!

12.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_AURVAEL_000_101
12.description: But know that you will face many difficulties. Why, I hear there is a great barrier of tempestuous aether dividing the upper and lower reaches, and you shall be hard-pressed indeed to scour every corner of the isles...

13.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_000_100
13.description: In order to register for an exploratory mission, you must be a level 60 Disciple of War or Magic.

14.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_000_101
14.description: Furthermore, you must be in possession of a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>mission ceruleum voucher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which may be purchased from Jaquoinie, the mission quartermaster.

15.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_000_102
15.description: Please be advised that preformed parties with less than eight players must abide by the composition requirement of one tank, two healers, and five DPS.

16.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_100_102
16.description: Parties formed for Trials of the Matron missions, however, are unrestricted with regards to numbers and composition.

17.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_000_103
17.description: Moreover, please note that the loot rules for matched parties prohibit the selection of Need.

18.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_000_104
18.description: Exploratory missions are subject to a time limit, and you will earn a reward by completing mission objectives within the time given.

19.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_101_104
19.description: Successfully completing a mission also earns you the ability to manipulate aetherial gaps, allowing you to pass beyond the Grounding Gale.

20.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_100_104
20.description: Furthermore, please be advised that you will not be permitted to change to a Disciple of the Land or Hand while on a Trials of the Fury exploratory mission.

21.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_102_104
21.description: Please also be aware that Disciples of War or Magic higher than level 60 will be automatically level synced upon entry.

22.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_000_105
22.description: All items in a player's loot list will automatically be transferred to that player's inventory upon all other party members leaving the area.

23.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_000_106
23.description: Items unable to be obtained will be lost.

24.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_000_107
24.description: Please note that once you have participated in an exploratory mission, you may not do so again for 30 minutes (Earth time).

25.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_AURVAEL_000_200
25.description: Oh, you never know what you might find out there, especially considering the number of expeditions being mounted by free companies and sky pirates─many of which fail miserably and are forced to withdraw.

26.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_AURVAEL_000_201
26.description: Aye, people are dying out there. Greenhorns and seasoned veterans alike. And while that is a tragedy, it may be another's boon, for if they have forged a strong spiritbond with their gear, it may become infused with the wearer's aether upon his death, rendering it that much more powerful.

27.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_AURVAEL_000_202
27.description: What I find fascinating though is the tremendous variety to be found. Ah, but I suppose it is the inevitable result of glamour prisms becoming so popular with adventurers.

28.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_AURVAEL_100_202
28.description: A tempting venture, is it not? I should note, however, that ofttimes the most valuable of treasures are shut inside sturdy lockboxes.

29.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_AURVAEL_110_202
29.description: But rather than turn to the ungentle solution of hammer or axe to break them open, I would suggest employing the services of a lockpicker. You would not wish to risk damaging the riches inside, would you?

30.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_AURVAEL_000_203
30.description: In any case, should you have no need of the items you recover, House Haillenarte would be most grateful for the contribution.

31.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_AURVAEL_000_204
31.description: Our spoils traders will recompense you for any such gear with sky pirate spoils. Mayhap you are unfamiliar with the currency?

32.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_AURVAEL_000_205
32.description: They are trophies, after a fashion. Items taken from the airships raided in the Sea of Clouds. A bit barbaric, perhaps, but as they are already in common use... <sigh>

33.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_AURVAEL_000_206
33.description: And should you wish to part with your newfound spoils, you may exchange them for an assortment of goods by speaking with one of our spoils collectors.

34.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_100_000
34.description: Certain gear obtained during the course of an exploratory mission can be exchanged for <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>brass sky pirate spoils<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> by speaking with spoils traders in Ishgard, the Diadem, or in any residential district.

35.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_100_001
35.description: Moreover, Disciples of the Land can gather <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>steel sky pirate spoils<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the Diadem after completing a Trials of the Matron mission.

36.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_100_002
36.description: These spoils can then be redeemed for a variety of valuable goods by speaking with spoils collectors, who can be found in the company of spoils traders.

37.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLAND2ENTRANCE_00385_SYSTEM_000_200
37.description: You cannot register for an exploratory mission while using the Duty Finder.
